{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN

# Check for any non-numeric values that were converted to NaN
df['revenue'].isna().sum()"}
